gloss: many fields; various directions; many aspects

definitions.gloss: many fields; many areas; various directions
definitions.explanation: Refers to multiple areas, fields, or directions. Used when something extends across or comes from many different areas.

examples.japanese: {多方面|たほうめん}から{意見|いけん}を{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: To gather opinions from many quarters.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{多方面|たほうめん}で{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: He is active in many fields.

examples.japanese: {多方面|たほうめん}にわたる{知識|ちしき}を{持|も}つ{彼女|かのじょ}は、どんな{話題|わだい}にも{対応|たいおう}できる。
examples.english: With her knowledge spanning many fields, she can engage with any topic.

notes:
Composed of {多|た} (many) + {方面|ほうめん} (direction, field, area). Can refer to literal multiple directions or figurative multiple fields of activity or expertise. Often used with particles に, から, or にわたる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多方面|たほうめん}にわたる — spanning many areas
- {多方面|たほうめん}で{活躍|かつやく}する — to be active in many fields
- {多方面|たほうめん}から — from many quarters/directions
- {多方面|たほうめん}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to affect many areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多面的|ためんてき} — multifaceted; adjective describing something with many aspects
- {各方面|かくほうめん} — various quarters, all directions; emphasizes 'each' rather than 'many'
- {幅広|はばひろ}い — wide-ranging, broad; more everyday term
